Game Overview

In Ninja Assassin, the core idea is straightforward: enter Ninja Assassin's world of thrill and challenge, where endless speed tests your reflexes. Dodge perilous obstacles and confront lethal monsters while collecting coins for power-ups that enhance your journey. With increasing speed and intuitive controls, every run unveils a fresh and exhilarating challenge.
